judgement.reason: Huly is a stack of many cooperating application services (front, account, collaborator, stream, media, preview, link-preview and others, each with its own image) that must run together, along with Kafka-compatible Redpanda and Elasticsearch, and Deployz runs only one web service per deployment.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: pods/ holds the Dockerfiles of 11 component images (account, backup, collaborator, front, fulltext, link-preview), so the app is a stack of cooperating services. Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The repository is a multi-service platform, and nothing shown proves that the stream image runs alone in production.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares cockroach (cockroachdb/cockroach:latest-v24.3) in dev/docker-compose.yaml; redpanda (docker.redpanda.com/redpandadata/redpanda:v24.3.6) in dev/docker-compose.yaml; elastic (elasticsearch:7.14.2) in dev/docker-compose.yaml; redis (redis:8.0.2-alpine3.21) in dev/docker-compose.yaml. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The services are declared in a dev compose file, but the shown lines do not prove that production stream avoids CockroachDB, Redpanda or Elasticsearch; the stream container's queue config and region point at them.
